name: Boyband Hell
source:
A2E was the top-performing boy band in the world before they split up. Two years later, the former band gets a mysterious call from their ex-leader El, who invites them to a secret Superfan-sponsored reunion. But once they arrive, they find themselves trapped unless they play an internet-fueled game show.
